label: Target window: soft and electronically conductive
note: Team-chosen bounds for discussion, not a literature value: roughly brain-like stiffness (0.1-100 kPa) with conductivity of at least 10 S/m. The lower bound sits above what saline (~1.5 S/m) and brain tissue (~0.1-1 S/m) conduct through ions alone, so a plain hydrogel soaked in buffer doesn't count as conductive.
